text:
ANTIFRAUD::alert_username
Description
This iRules command returns a username and for phishing also
additional fields.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
alert_username
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
{
log
local0.
"Alert username: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_username]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
